# F08

Synthetic statistics fixture; derived, unsigned, never a headline.

Construction: Seeded Gaussian body with six negative and two positive tail points; deterministic coordinate search. Seed: 2026101008.

Draw 180 gauss(0,1) values. Replace indices 0–5 with -a, 178–179 with b. Minimise (skew+2.1)^2+(excess_kurtosis-8.4)^2. Grid: a=3..12, b=0..7, step 0.25. From grid best, try eight coordinate/diagonal neighbours, accept the minimum tuple, otherwise halve step; stop below 1e-10. Result a=7.178842325811274, b=4.488275248091668, moves=96, objective=4.865911449013992e-21. Affine transform to sample sd=0.01 and SR=2.4/sqrt(252), then round to e8; moments and targets are not forced after rounding.

The stored e8 integers are authoritative. Design targets are construction goals, not expectations. Expectations come exclusively from the independent stdlib oracle using SPEC-03 E1–E15. The integers use round-to-nearest, ties-to-even.
